TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Enable Archean Tweaks
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: This entire section is disabled by default for compatibility sake mostly, some Archean related tweaks function regardless of if they've been changed (any changing a radius for example) so this allows them all to be skipped over without any potential for conflicts if you prefer another archean tweak mod.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Replantable Archean
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: Makes it so you can move Archean trees like any other.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Effect Radius
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: The radius in which the archean tree will convert terrain to rich soil.

TweaksGalore.TweakDef.label: Effect Rate
TweaksGalore.TweakDef.description: Seconds for each tile the Archean tree converts.
